description: When deterministic signals are exhausted, surface ranked candidate domains for orphaned chunks by reusing scenario-dependency-analyzer's Ollama+Qdrant pipeline; suggestions only — never auto-applied.

requirements.description: When deterministic signals are exhausted and no placement verdict meets the confidence threshold, cartographer may surface ranked candidate domains for orphaned chunks by reusing scenario-dependency-analyzer's Ollama+Qdrant pipeline (AC-P2-EMBED-RANKER). Suggestions are surfaced as candidates only and are never auto-applied. This capability is strictly P2 and must not be present in v1. The embedding ranker must be an optional plugin that activates only when explicitly configured in the manifest.
requirements.title: Embedding-Based Suggestion Ranker for Orphaned Chunks

validation.notes: Embedding ranker plugin is not invoked when not configured in manifest
Embedding ranker returns a ranked list of domain candidates with confidence scores, never a single auto-applied verdict
Suggestions from embedding ranker are clearly labeled as 'embedding-assisted' in the output to distinguish from deterministic signals
Embedding ranker integration test against a running Ollama+Qdrant fixture server returns ranked candidates for an orphaned file
Disabling Ollama in the environment causes the ranker to fail gracefully with a warning, not a hard error
No embedding-based suggestion is ever auto-applied; human or agent must explicitly accept before any action is taken
Embedding ranker is activated only for files where all deterministic signals return below-threshold confidence

title: Embedding-Based Suggestion Ranker
